intro: One plate of prawn aglio olio is about 600 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the pasta and the olive oil used for frying.
diet: Yes, this is one of the lighter pastas because there's no cream. But it can be quite oily, especially at cafés. The protein from the prawns is a bit low, so add more protein if you can. A good choice when you're eating out with friends.
tips: Ask for less oil when you order.
Add extra prawns or chicken for more protein.
Cooking at home? Measure just 1 tablespoon of oil per serving.

swap.name: Grilled chicken (skinless) with salad
swap.why: Higher protein and fewer calories, so you stay full longer.

faq.a: It usually has dried chilli or cili padi. How spicy depends on the shop. You can ask for less spicy.

faq.q: Is aglio olio healthier than carbonara?
faq.a: In terms of calories and saturated fat, yes, it's usually lower because there's no cream and less cheese.

faq.q: Is aglio olio easy to cook at home?
faq.a: Very easy. Boil spaghetti, fry garlic and chilli in a little oil, add prawns and toss with the pasta.
